scope: Exact code and title matches from three dated public OCW architecture syllabi; 115 visible department directory results reviewed as a bounded discovery route.

observation.name: Introduction to Art History
observation.prerequisites: There are no prerequisites for this course, and no prior knowledge of art history is required.

https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/4-601-introd.summary: Studies art in historical and social contexts, considering representation, patronage, materials, institutions and the changing roles of artists and artworks.
notes: Actual Fall 2018 OCW syllabus; current offering, prerequisite continuity and current registration eligibility are not established. Original requirement-list identity and role remain unchanged.

observation.name: Modern Art and Mass Culture
observation.prerequisites: There are no prerequisites for this course.

https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/4-602-modern.summary: Examines modern and contemporary art through its relationships with mass culture, industrial production, visual technologies, politics and cultural theory.
notes: Actual Spring 2012 OCW syllabus; current offering, prerequisite continuity and current registration eligibility are not established. Original requirement-list identity and role remain unchanged.

observation.name: Historiography of Islamic Architecture
observation.prerequisites: MIT students were required to obtain permission of the instructor.

https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/4-619-histor.summary: Critically examines scholarship on Islamic architecture, its historiography, periodization, cultural definitions and relationships with dominant architectural paradigms.
notes: Actual Fall 2014 OCW syllabus; current offering, prerequisite continuity and current registration eligibility are not established. Original requirement-list identity and role remain unchanged.
The dated source labels this a graduate course and requires MIT students to obtain instructor permission; undergraduate approval is not presumed.
